title: Damyang County Cultural Foundation says personal data may have leaked in Douzone Bizon backup-server breach
date_note: Dailysecu (25 Nov) says the foundation announced the possible leak on its website on 20 November.
geo_basis: county named in the foundation's name; the source gives no street address
summary: Dailysecu reports that the Damyang County Cultural Foundation said on its website on 20 November that personal information may have leaked through a breach of backup servers at its outsourced vendor Douzone Bizon. The report says signs point to some encrypted data being taken out via the APO backup service. The article says the leaked items, the scale of damage and whether the data can be decrypted have not been confirmed.
plain: A South Korean local culture foundation says personal data may have leaked after its software vendor's backup servers were breached. The items and scale are not yet confirmed.
exec: A vendor's backup-server breach may have exposed a foundation's personal data; the items and scale are not yet confirmed.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Dailysecu's report gives no advice for affected people.

evidence.quote: 현재까지 재단의 구체적인 개인정보 유출 항목과 피해 규모, 반출된 데이터의 복호화 여부 등은 확인되지 않았다.

validation.note: Single publisher (Dailysecu) relaying the foundation's website notice; the foundation's own notice was not read.
